SELECT: 评分下降幅度 (decline_rate_pct) = (first_season_rating - last_season_rating) / first_season_rating * 100

JOIN.description: 剧集关联 → 剧集标题

WHERE: ep.average_rating IS NOT NULL (剧集评分非空)
e.season_number IS NOT NULL (季号非空)
GROUP_BY: s.id, s.primary_title, e.season_number (按系列和季分组计算每季平均评分)
HAVING: COUNT(*) >= 3 (至少3季，确保有足够数据比较首末季)
ORDER_BY: decline_rate_pct DESC (按评分下降幅度降序)
